subject: part
title: (R)PART------ TR.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(CW)-17. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'To gain insight into the implications of creative women in improvised music is to in fact be confronted with the dynamic consequence of bi-aitionalism as well as the essence factor of creativity.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of participation structurally meets transformation at the creative-women bi-aitionalism scale: (R)PART crossed with TR. PART sits at lower-right with the subject-arrow; TR at upper-left as partner-axis. ATTN (attraction), MT-INFO (multi-information), PER-DY (perception dynamics) center. ALT-DEF (alternative definitions), ALT-F (alternative functionalism) center-right. POL-DY (political dynamics) left, RE-ST (restructuralism), IST-F (isolated focus) lower-center.
